environment.build: npm run build; npm run preview -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 4180 --strictPort
environment.instrumentation: Opt-in window.__AZNET_METRICS__; bounded local counters/timings only, no telemetry.

validation.build_warning: Existing bundle size warning (>500 kB). Generated-date version convention unchanged.
validation.lint_warning: One pre-existing ErLocationInfoModal set-state-in-effect warning remains. Browser-storage synchronization has a scoped, explained exception.
validation.browser_command: npx playwright test azure-net.spec.ts azure-net-bgp.spec.ts azure-net-routing-check.spec.ts canvas-presentation.spec.ts failures.spec.ts azure-net-path-motion.spec.ts azure-net-gateway-prefixes.spec.ts azure-comparison.spec.ts --workers=2 --reporter=list,json
validation.small_model_parity: Exact simulation, landscape analysis and diagnostic output equality for all five shipped flagship samples plus transit, advanced ARS/site-map and remote-ARS models; exact renamed trace and failure-report equality, including duplicate original VNet names.
additional_assertions: Malformed/missing collections, wrong scalar/enum shapes, duplicate/dangling IDs, excessive text/collections/aggregate values and nonfinite coordinates are rejected.
All existing Azure Networking JSON fixtures remain admitted; optional advanced ARS attributes and bounded unknown observations round-trip.
Unreadable originals are preserved/exportable until acknowledgement; failed imports and quota failure retain the active design.
Share/edit/reload and same-document shared-link imports consume snapshots once; explicit samples still supersede previously saved shared metadata.
Cancel, lost capture and Escape discard preview; keyboard moves, one-step undo/redo and reload persistence remain correct.
Parallel ER geometry and policy anchors move live without losing link IDs.
Presentation edits retain cached simulation, connectivity, trace, diagnostics and N-1 evidence, with current names in prose/Bicep; region edits invalidate routing.
Existing gateway summaries, advanced ARS/site maps, route/failure evidence, motion alignment, fit/reset and presentation controls pass browser regressions.

method.models: Flagship hub/spoke topology expanded to 21 or 61 VNets, respectively 100 or 500 on-premises prefixes, hub transit peerings and active bounded landscape analysis.
method.gesture: One 16-step real mouse drag per model; capture actual simulation/analysis/diagnostic/persistence counters before preview, during preview and after pointer-up. Verify live edge geometry, saved coordinates, single undo, redo and reload.
method.latency: Elapsed performance.now() from the SVG pointermove listener to a nested requestAnimationFrame callback. This is a browser next-frame proxy, not physical display latency.
method.p95: Nearest-rank percentile across 16 samples; p95 is therefore the maximum in these bounded runs.
method.durable_counts_exclude: Initial load, subsequent undo/redo and reload.
method.reference_only: Issue #91 quoted ~217 ms simulation and ~1.15 s active pair analysis for a 61-VNet/500-prefix synthetic model. These runs measure a bounded landscape check, not an identical routing microbenchmark.

limitations: Single bounded gesture per synthetic model with concurrent two-worker browser load; timings vary with scheduling/JIT/DOM size and are not a 60 FPS guarantee.
This removes repeated routing work from interactions; it does not merge or optimize the underlying routing engines or rewrite the renderer.
If browser storage access itself is denied, inaccessible original bytes cannot be exported; automatic overwrite remains blocked until explicit acknowledgement.
Semantic routing problems remain editable warnings. Native admission guarantees bounded structural completeness/references, not a fully routable or deployable design.
No cloud operations, deployments, push, PR, merge or provider orders were performed. Full CI and production-host release checks remain with the parent.
